Verdigris-bronze scale cuirass articulated for female anatomy, fitted over a sleeveless saffron linen under-layer — bare shoulders and forearms, high-waisted leather breeches, brass-buckled belt cinching her waist, hand-engraved pauldron on one shoulder. Warm-climate Dornish scout, light and lethal.

Full Cormyrean half-plate in polished steel, every panel engraved with silver-thread floral runs — shieldmaiden chest articulation, flared tassets over a crimson surcoat, gorget, vambraces, greaves. She is entirely covered in ornate war-iron, silhouette unmistakably feminine.

No coat. No layers. Just a fitted forest-green gambeson, sleeveless, laced tight at her ribs, tooled leather bracers at both forearms, olive high-waisted breeches tucked into knee-high boots. Eriador ranger. Arms bare to the shoulder, practical and spare.

Oxblood brocade travel-robe fitted close through the bodice and belted at the waist with a wide brass-pinned sorcerer's girdle — skirt falling to mid-calf, silver runic embroidery at collar and cuffs, a single shoulder-clasp holding a charcoal wool half-cape. Waterdhavian battle-mage.

Bare legs from mid-thigh down. A short Skellige battle-kilt of layered oxhide panels, riveted at the hip, worn under a fitted sleeveless leather cuirass with sculpted chest plates — high laced boots, iron-studded vambraces, copper-pinned shoulder guard. Athletic. Fierce. Not cheesecake.

Pewter-grey full plate — Leyndell knight, every surface hand-engraved with interlocking thorned vines. Cuirass shaped to her torso with distinct feminine chest articulation, fluted greaves, articulated gauntlets, a swept-back helmet under one arm. Entirely encased. Wholly regal.

Pale bone-white fitted linen tunic, sleeveless, gathered at a narrow tooled-leather waist-belt — worn over sand-tan high-waisted breeches, light scale-mail collar, and engraved vambraces. No cloak, no coat. Haradrim-tradition desert explorer. Warm-climate single-layer, form-following.

Wine-red Nilfgaardian fitted coat — hip-length, double-breasted, brass-buttoned from collar to waist — over a charcoal close-fit gambeson and black breeches. Waist pulled in by a tooled leather belt. Subtle, authoritative, the armor hidden under court-grade tailoring.

A fitted bustier-cut steel cuirass — real hammered plate, sculpted to her form, NOT decorative — worn directly over bare skin above a short combat skirt of overlapping leather and mail. Toned midriff framed by armor's lower edge. Dark teal enamel inlay. Stranglethorn mercenary.

Indigo wool cleric's vestments, full-coverage, shaped to follow the curve of her waist by a wide silver-clasped girdle — embroidered silver-thread prayers at every hem, heavy wool skirts to the ankle, engraved bracers, a fur-lined hood. Gondorian temple road-scholar. Cold-temperate dignity.

No armor at all — a Highgarden bardic doublet in amber brocade, fitted through the torso, off-shoulder cut on the left side, paired with cream high-waisted riding breeches and knee-high heeled boots. Tooled leather travelling satchel. Civilian but unmistakably classed.

Mud-stained. One pauldron repaired with mismatched rivets. She wears a cobalt Dúnedain ranger's fitted leather coat — hip-length, open-fronted over a grey wool fitted tunic, charcoal breeches, worn but hand-engraved bracers. The road has left its mark on every seam.

Fitted russet linen halter-top, one-shoulder cut, under an open sleeveless leather over-jacket with brass pin fastenings — high-waisted dark breeches, a wide tooled belt. Bare arm on the open side, vambrace on the other. Redguard light-scout. Warm-climate, asymmetric, capable.

Carian sorcerer's cassock — deep amethyst, floor-length, fitted through the bodice with visible waist shaping and a wide engraved silver clasp belt — embroidered runic spirals at the hem and sleeves, a scaled shoulder-mantle, no hood. Fully covered. The silhouette reads power, not anonymity.

Sleeveless Bosmer scout leathers in forest-green and bark-brown, fitted to her silhouette with tooled rib-panels — bare shoulders, engraved bracers from wrist to elbow, a narrow hip belt with brass-pinned quiver loops. Lightweight. Every edge hand-tooled with leaf-rune borders.

She wears a toned midriff under a fitted Chultan explorer's scaled chest piece — hammered jade-green scales over a narrow fitted under-band, high-waisted leather breeches with runic-tooled waistband, high laced boots, engraved vambraces. Warm jungle climate, single-piece armor as focal point.

Full Skellige winter-gear: heavy fur-and-hide outer cloak over a fitted steel-grey leather cuirass with feminine chest articulation, layered wool under-robe, thick bracers, iron gorget. Every visible edge reinforced and hand-engraved. Silhouette broad-shouldered and imposing. The cold made armor.

A fitted silk-and-mail Quel'Thalas scout robe — coral-pink silk panels alternating with fine silverite mail, shaped to the torso, belted at the waist, split skirt to mid-thigh over fitted breeches and silver-laced boots. Runic silver-thread at every seam. Mid-coverage, elegant, ready.

Bare arms, bare from the collarbone across one shoulder — a sleeveless fitted leather battle-jerkin in dark teal over a short combat skirt, engraved brass hip-plates, high-laced fighting boots. Drow surface-scout. She is compact, precise, the armor leaving nothing to chance and nothing to leer at.

Soot-grey Thayan wool travel-robe, fully covering, cut fitted through the torso with a wide obsidian-clasped waist-girdle — long flared sleeves edged in scarlet runic embroidery, high collar, knee-high boots visible at the hem. Mage-register. Shape defined by the belt alone.

Cream linen fitted riding outfit — tailored tunic tucked into high-waisted breeches, a sleeved light-mail hauberk left open at the collar, engraved steel bracers, and a single tooled-leather sword-baldric crossing the chest. Cormyrean cavalry road clothes. No extra layer. Temperate elegance.

Ironborn shieldmaiden plate — every panel sea-worn and salt-pitted, but the chest articulation is clean feminine-curve forged steel under a riveted leather surcoat in dark iron-grey. Vambraces. Gorget. Short mail skirt over fitted breeches. Lived-in, coastal, fully armored.

The focal point is the belt — a magnificent tooled-steel affair cinching the waist of a fitted Dunmer battle-sorceress's coat: ankle-length charcoal fitted coat, open at the lower half to show dark breeches and high boots, one bare arm, one vambraced. Volcanic material palette.

Steel-grey Witcher School-of-Wolf leathers on a female witcher — fitted to every line of her silhouette, reinforced rib panels, sculpted chest, tooled wolf-medallion at the sternum, vambraces, slim-cut breeches, soft-soled boots. No fur, no hood, no extra drape. Just the suit.

Saffron and russet layered Aen Seidhe elven gown-armor — a fitted brocade bodice shaped at the waist, sleeveless, bare shoulders above engraved gold vambraces, flowing split-skirt to the ankle over close-fit breeches. Silver runic embroidery spiraling hem to waist. Half-gown, half-armor, all presence.

Charcoal half-plate shaped to her feminine silhouette — Gondorian-forged cuirass with breast articulation, engraved pauldrons trailing a short steel-grey surcoat, vambraces runic-stamped in silver thread, fitted over a slate wool gambeson; fully-covered, cold-temperate, paladin-register.

Bare arms, bare shoulders — a sleeveless fitted oxblood leather jerkin laced tight at the waist over high-waisted dark breeches, Dúnedain ranger-cut, brass buckle at the hip, hand-tooled bracers climbing to the elbow; warm and capable, mid-climate, no cloak at all.

Saffron and sand-tan — a single-layer Redguard-Hammerfell fitted travel tunic, belted at the waist to define her silhouette, lightweight scale panels at the shoulders and hips, thin linen sleeves rolled to the elbow, open-faced hood; warm-climate light armor, material-led.

Deep forest-green wool sorceress cassock fitted through the bodice to mid-calf, Carian court-cut, silver-thread runic banding at collar and cuffs, a narrow cinched waist-sash, dark jade glass buttons; no armor anywhere — the silhouette alone reads dangerous; temperate mage-register.

What she is NOT wearing: no breastplate, no pauldrons, no coat. Just a sleeveless fitted Dornish-analogous leather combat bodice over a bare midriff, high-waisted rust-red breeches, knee-high laced boots; warm-climate scout, toned and lean, tastefully skin-showing without a trace of cheesecake.

Worn at the right bracer where the strap-leather has been re-stitched twice — Skellige shieldmaiden half-plate, the breast panels cold-hammered for female anatomy, a fur-edged war-kilt falling mid-thigh over bare athletic legs, iron-riveted gorget, amber beads at the pauldron clasp; cold-climate, heavily lived-in.

Wine-red brocade fitted riding coat, hip-length, Highgarden-Reach civilian-adventurer register, tailored to follow the curve of her waist, brass-pinned at the chest, narrow trousers and short heeled boots beneath; no armor, no hood; temperate, silhouette-led, deliberately elegant.

Cobalt fitted tunic tucked into high-waisted dark trousers — sleeveless, Bosmer-Valenwood-analogous, a short combat skirt of layered leather strips over bare legs, laced sandal-boots to the knee; warm-climate, light and unencumbered, spare runic stitching at the hem the only ornament.

Pewter and bone-white — a full Cormyrean plate ensemble, articulated gauntlets, fluted greaves, a plumed great-helm at her hip; the breastplate engraved with a twin-dragon device; fitted to female anatomy without exaggeration; cold-temperate, fully-covered, heavy-armored, silhouette proud and martial.

Amethyst-purple Thayan travel-robe, fitted through the bodice, skirt to ankle, asymmetric one-shoulder construction leaving the right arm and shoulder bare, a silver-thread arcane binding spiraling from wrist to elbow; warm-climate mage, tastefully skin-showing in exactly one deliberate gesture.

Verdigris-bronze scale cuirass over a thin cream under-layer, Quel'Thalas elven-craft, each scale scallop-edged and engraved; fitted skirt-of-linked-chain over leather hip-wrapping to mid-thigh, bare legs below, tall gilded greaves; temperate, mid-armored, color-palette-led in hammered green-gold.

Russet and bark-brown hide — Chultan jungle-scout, sleeveless fitted leather vest shaped to her torso, bare arms tattooed in Forgotten-Realms vine-script, short leather battle-kilt above the knee, ankle-wrap boots; warm-climate, tastefully skin-showing, lived-in leather cracked at the shoulders from hard use.

Indigo wool fitted long-coat, Nilfgaardian officer cut, belted twice — once at the waist, once at the hip — over a matching fitted high-collar tunic; silver pip engraving at the cuffs; no skin showing at all; temperate, fully-covered, civilian-military authority.

Steel-grey Imperial Cyrodiil half-plate, the pauldrons engraved with wheat-stalk borders, a fitted surcoat of olive wool beneath cut to the knee-front and ankle-back, articulated vambraces, plain but immaculate; temperate paladin, fully-covered, silhouette clean and workmanlike-proud.

Cream and coral-pink — a Waterdhavian bardic doublet fitted at the waist, slashed sleeves revealing a coral under-layer, a short split-front skirt to mid-thigh over dark fitted hose and ankle boots; temperate civilian-adventurer, mid-coverage, ornate brass-pinned front closure.

No hood, no cloak, no layers — just a jade-green fitted Aen Seidhe leather tunic, sleeveless, cut to show bare shoulders and arms, tooled with leaf-vein patterns across the chest; high-waisted fitted breeches, tall laced boots; mid-climate elven scout, skin-showing and unashamed.

Deep teal wool monastic cassock with a fitted Witcher-school modification — a corseted leather over-bodice cinched at the waist, mail skirt to the knee, bracers of dark iron; cold-climate, fully-covered, hybrid robes-and-armor silhouette, silver-threaded rune-bands at every hem.

Amber and rust-red — a Rohirrim shieldmaiden fitted riding dress of heavy linen, knee-length, belted at the waist with a wide tooled-leather swordbelt, a light mail hauberk beneath the bodice, tall brown riding boots; temperate, mid-coverage, the classic LOTR idiom worn lean and tailored.

Olive fitted sleeveless gambeson over a thin sand-tan shirt, Eriador-ranger cut, bare arms, brass-riveted leather bracers, narrow fitted breeches tucked into short laced boots; warm-to-temperate, single-layer, no coat; the worn left pauldron strap re-stitched in a different thread color — lived-in detail.

A short Stranglethorn scout-kilt of layered dark leather strips swings to mid-thigh over bare athletic legs; above it a fitted off-shoulder leather breastplate, one shoulder bare, one guarded by a small spiked pauldron; warm-climate, tastefully skin-showing, Warcraft jungle-register done with craft.
